definitions.explanation: Describes an object manufactured from porcelain, a hard, white, translucent ceramic fired at high temperatures. Used as a noun modifier to indicate the material of tableware, decorative items, and other objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{磁器|じき}{製|せい}だ。
examples.english: This teacup is made of porcelain.

examples.japanese: {磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割|わ}れ→割れる：00907_wareru⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Porcelain vases are fragile and require care.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Arita ware is a representative Japanese porcelain tableware that is also highly regarded overseas.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧ (porcelain) and ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of, manufactured from). The suffix ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ is productive and attaches to many materials: ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧ (wooden), ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧ (metal), ⟦{革製|かわせい}→革製：26255_kawasei⟧ (leather), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧: porcelain tableware
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧: porcelain doll
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧: porcelain vase
- {磁器|じき}{製|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧: porcelain tile

JAPANESE PORCELAIN:
- ⟦{有田焼|ありたやき}→有田焼：28604_aritayaki⟧: Arita ware (Saga Prefecture)
- {九谷焼|くたにやき}: Kutani ware (Ishikawa Prefecture)
- {伊万里焼|いまりやき}: Imari ware (Saga Prefecture)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of earthenware/pottery — ⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧ is softer and more porous than ⟦{磁器|じき}→磁器：03335_jiki⟧
- ⟦{陶磁器|とうじき}→陶磁器：15698_toujiki⟧: ceramics — the collective term for both pottery and porcelain
- {瀬戸物|せともの}: ceramic ware — a colloquial term for ceramics in general
